style.backgroundSystem: only four warm background planes across the whole set: a sun-warmed terracotta plaster wall #B4552C, a deep jade plaster field #0E5C4C, a rice-apricot paper card #EEDDBE and a matte slate-grey stone plane #8B8478 used only for the macro screen; the hero screen always shows one hard horizontal edge where the terracotta wall #B4552C meets the jade table plane #0E5C4C, one dominant plane per screen, no gradient, no marble, no sky, no botanical shadow cut-outs, no pure seamless studio white, no cool grey backdrop, no landscape scenery
style.direction: warm terracotta-and-jade pantry still-life for dried tonic pieces
style.iconSystem: hollow thin-line marks at one uniform stroke weight, each inside a square bracket frame with notched corners, warm gold #D9B36B on the jade plane #0E5C4C and deep jade #0E5C4C on the apricot card #EEDDBE, max four per screen; solid deep jade #0E5C4C vertical bars used only as empty grade rails; no diamond lozenge badges, no dotted circles, no filled discs, no bird or leaf silhouettes

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm terracotta-and-jade pantry still-life ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a sun-warmed terracotta plaster wall #B4552C, a deep jade plaster field and table plane #0E5C4C, a rice-apricot paper card #EEDDBE and one warm gold hairline accent #D9B36B; warm tone throughout; warm 4300-4800K directional key from the upper left with a large rice-apricot bounce card at the right, low to mid contrast, dry fibrous matte highlights with no specular bloom and one soft defined contact shadow that always grounds the product, never a cool cast and never a wet glossy sheen; one modern geometric sans-serif for headline and label placeholders only, rice-apricot #EEDDBE lettering on jade #0E5C4C and deep jade #0E5C4C lettering on apricot #EEDDBE, no calligraphy, no serif, no pinyin or english eyebrow lines; hollow thin-line marks of one uniform stroke inside square bracket frames with notched corners plus solid deep jade #0E5C4C empty vertical bars as grade rails, no more than four per screen; backgrounds limited to the terracotta wall #B4552C, the jade plane #0E5C4C, the apricot card #EEDDBE and one matte slate-grey stone plane #8B8478 for the macro screen only, one dominant plane per screen, no gradient, no marble, no pure seamless studio white, no cool grey backdrop; surfaces limited to a dark walnut board #4A2C1D, a slate-grey stone counter #8B8478, a woven bamboo tray with dry straw #C8A466, a gold-rimmed white porcelain stew cup #F4EFE6 and washed grey linen #B7AC9C; stable product scale with the dry goods always matte, fibrous and never bleached, the stewed state only inside the porcelain cup; generous warm negative space; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no gift tin or ribbon packaging, no brand mark, no QR code, no membership badge.
noDrift: no cool grey, blue or ivory-white studio system
no glossy, wet or plastic-looking rendering of the dry goods
no gift tin, round box, ribbon, jar, bottle or sachet packaging

style.presentationRules: the dry pieces are always shown whole and standing on their own base or leaning in a receding row, matte and fibrous with the fine thread network visible; the soaked and stewed state appears only inside the gold-rimmed porcelain cup #F4EFE6 as separated translucent strands; product scale stays constant across the set and every piece keeps a visible contact shadow; no piece is bleached, powdered, pressed into a cake, glossed or recoloured
